create.name: Rodney Yee & Colleen Saidman Yee
create.bio:
Rodney Yee and Colleen Saidman Yee are a married couple who have taught yoga together for some two decades from Sag Harbor, New York. Rodney grew up in California, studied philosophy and physical therapy, danced with the Oakland Ballet, then trained in the Iyengar method in the Bay Area and co-founded Piedmont Yoga in 1987; his long run of Gaiam yoga videos, and a 2000 appearance on Oprah, did much to bring yoga into American living rooms. Colleen worked for years as a fashion model, trained with Jivamukti in 1998 and studied shiatsu, and opened Yoga Shanti in Sag Harbor in 1999. Her memoir and practice guide Yoga for Life came out with Simon & Schuster in 2015.

Their shared style rests on Iyengar and Ashtanga roots: careful alignment and sequencing joined with breath work, meditation and philosophy, with a steady interest in why a practice is done as well as how. They lead the Yoga Shanti teacher trainings, which can be followed in person or online, teach regular studio and livestream classes, and run weekend retreats at Kripalu, Menla and Omega, while Colleen also hosts a yearly women's retreat in Mexico. Together with Donna Karan they created the Urban Zen Integrative Therapy programme, and Rodney has co-written two books on practice.

books.title: Yoga for Life: A Journey to Inner Peace and Freedom
books.author: Colleen Saidman Yee, with Rodney Yee
books.description: Colleen's account of her life, from modelling and hard times to finding yoga, woven together with illustrated practice sequences. Each chapter pairs a stage of her story with poses and breathing for that theme.

books.title: Moving Toward Balance: 8 Weeks of Yoga with Rodney Yee
books.author: Rodney Yee, Nina Zolotow
books.description: An eight-week home programme that builds a balanced practice step by step, with photographed sequences, guidance on alignment and reflections on bringing yoga into daily life.

books.title: Yoga: The Poetry of the Body
books.author: Rodney Yee, Nina Zolotow
books.description: Rodney's first book, a photographed guide to the main families of poses with practice sequences. It mixes clear technique with personal reflections on what the practice can open up.

courses.title: 300HR Advanced Yoga Teacher Training
courses.description: A five-month advanced training with Colleen and Rodney for experienced practitioners and teachers, taken in Sag Harbor, online or as a mix. It covers advanced asana, pranayama, philosophy and anatomy, with mentoring in a small community.
courses.price: $4,100 USD new students, $3,500 USD returning students

courses.title: The Full Scope of Yoga Weekend Retreat
courses.description: An all-levels weekend with Colleen and Rodney at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts. Sessions combine postures, breathing, meditation and philosophy, timed to the body's natural daily rhythms.

courses.title: Joy of the Yogini: Annual Women's Yoga Retreat
courses.description: Colleen's yearly women's retreat, taking over a small beachfront hotel in Tulum, Mexico, for five nights of daily yoga, rest and time by the sea. Rates cover room, meals and classes.
courses.price: $3,100–$6,800 USD all-inclusive, by room ($500 USD deposit)

courses.title: New Year's Day Practice
courses.description: A ninety-minute open-level class with Colleen and Rodney on the first morning of 2027, at Yoga Shanti or by livestream, using postures, breath and mindfulness to begin the year together.

courses.title: Yoga Shanti Classes
courses.description: Regular classes at Yoga Shanti in Sag Harbor and by livestream, including classes with Colleen and Rodney, plus a library of recorded classes. Available as single classes, class packs or monthly subscriptions.
courses.price: $35 USD single in-person class; Gold hybrid subscription $385 USD per month

free_resources.title: Free 5 Minute Meditations
free_resources.description: Seven short guided meditations from Colleen, one for each day of a week, free to download from her website.

free_resources.title: Yoga For Life Podcast
free_resources.description: Colleen's podcast of talks and conversations on self-worth, fear, forgiveness, relationships and spiritual life, with guests including Roshi Joan Halifax and Rev. angel Kyodo williams.

flags: Couple listing named 'Rodney Yee & Colleen Saidman Yee' with slug rodney-yee-colleen-saidman-yee as briefed: they co-lead the teacher training, retreats and Commune course, and both teach at Yoga Shanti. Some items are one partner's only (Tulum retreat and podcast: Colleen; two books and most videos: Rodney).

Tier borderline: ~127.5k summed across both partners' accounts (80k–150k band). Rodney's stature (Gaiam videos with millions of views, Oprah 2000) could justify a higher tier by editorial stature; the owner decides. No tier_override set.
Commune course 'Simple Self-Care' left out: it's sold on easing pain, improving sleep, digestion and mood, and uses 'yoga therapy' for patients. teaches_at still links Commune.

Email sagharbor@yogashanti.com is the studio's inbox (a visible mailto link on the prices page and the email icon on rodneyyeeyoga.com); training@yogashanti.com is published for teacher-training questions.
First photo shows both partners together (couple listing); the other two are solo photos of Rodney and of Colleen from their own sites.
Videos are on other channels (Gaiam, plumtv, Reserve Channel, Marie Forleo), where one or both of them lead; neither has an active own YouTube channel.
They teach at Kripalu, Omega and Menla (future hubs or not hubs); neither is in omega-institute-faculty.json, so only Commune is in teaches_at.
Urban Zen Integrative Therapy (UZIT) is mentioned in the bio as their creation, but it's a hospital and caregiver programme (yoga therapy, Reiki, essential oils), so it isn't linked as an offering.
